testcase.name: Scenario: Switch between a drawing and a part being edited: tmp/obk-mixed-switch-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:160:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch between a drawing and a part being edited ✔ Given a drawing and a part are open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the part has an active sketch editing environment ✔ And the drawing is active with its drawing resources branch collapsed ✔ When the user selects the part document tab ✔ Then the part sketch viewport and model browser are displayed ✔ And the sketch ribbon is active ✔ When the user selects the drawing document tab ✔ Then the drawing sheet and drawing browser are displayed ✔ And the drawing ribbon is active ✔ And the drawing resources branch is collapsed ✔ And the part remains available as an open tab ✔ When the user selects the part document tab again ✔ Then the part sketch viewport and model browser are displayed ✔ And the sketch editing environment remains active
